relationships.evidence_quote: Our study indicated that the expression of KCC2 in the ACC and PAG regions of the brain decreased after SCI, but increased after treatment with HU-MSCs.

relationships.subject: spinal cord injury
relationships.evidence_quote: the expression of CGRP, SP and C-Fos increased, and that of KCC2 decreased, in the ACC and PAG in models of SCI

relationships.subject: HU-MSCs
relationships.evidence_quote: Local injection of HU-MSCs significantly ameliorated the mechanical hyperalgesia caused by SCI

key_findings: Local HU-MSC injection at the SCI site partially relieved mechanical hyperalgesia and improved motor recovery but not thermal hypersensitivity.
SCI raised CGRP, SP and C-Fos and lowered KCC2 in ACC and PAG; HU-MSCs reversed these changes.
